notes.title: Co OPERATION v0.9.0 New sounds and gameplay
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/1d46d431ebfa30304b5cad2dd4ca6e9b826fdb12.jpg[/img]
We're getting close! We just uploaded v0.9.0 of the Co OPERATION: MultiTurn demo to Steam.

It's amazing the difference adding sounds effects can make. For too long we had temporary sounds that were always meant to be replaced. Well, now they have been! As we now have 17 tracks of really cool music by French Horn Jazz artist Jim Rattigan in the game, we went for sounds that compliment the gameplay but don't interfere with the music. Most of the sounds are realistic Foley sounds rather than "melodic video gamey sounds" that could conflict with the music. Tell us what you think. In testing, to us, it feels like an extra feeling of satisfaction has been added as it feels like your game actions are more "real" now.

Please try the new version and then drop us some [url=https://discord.gg/5RSq85mQ6q]feedback on Discord[/url] or via the in-game feedback form.

The full patch notes are below for v0.9.0.

Also, the game has been included in the Turn Based fest on Steam which should be live on Steam shortly after I hit send on this message. There will be a lot of established and also new and upcoming games there, all with turn-based mechanics.

v0.9.0 Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] 🎲Knock-back feature added. Players and patients can be knocked into the adjacent tile when bumped into.
[*] 🎵 New sound effects added! It was about time we replaced the temporary sounds we had added aaaages ago.
[*] 🎲 The controller button that looks like “undo” now behaves like this. When you press it, your actions are wiped and you can enter new actions.
[*] 🎲 Medicine can be passed to another player on the next tile using “interact”.
[*] 🎨 Sparkles and better visual feedback when you buy an item.
[*] 🎵 Each time you unlock the next set of levels, you get a new mini-playlist of music as you play.
[*] 🎨 New “Attract Mode” video added to the join screen, with updated gameplay and visuals.
[*] 🔧Various improvements and fixes.
[*] 
[*] For modders:
[*] 🔧 You can specify the pitch range, volume and a delay for sounds from the YAML and LUA scripts.
[*] 🔧Various improvements and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Co OPERATION v0.8.2 - More big changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/ebb167dfeafdd679c29e0c467bfe0c0d4816388f.jpg[/img]

Another big update to Co OPERATION is out. You can play the demo version on Steam as a preview of the upcoming full game release. It feels like this game is really starting to come together into a cohesive experience. We did intend to have already released the full game by now, but made a decision to improve it some more, both in terms of systems and the amount of polish. I don't know how many people will end up playing the final release, but whether that's a small or a large amount of players, we want to make sure that the experience is excellent and that the vast majority of players feel that the game deserves a good review on Steam.

Like a lot of indie game creators, I tend to get a bit obsessive with the creative projects I'm involved with, but I am aware of that so have asked the team to speak up if I'm asking them add "just one more thing" which might be unnecessary or overly complicated. So they do! I think we're achieving a good balance of only adding features to the game which will make the core experience better (rather than being distracting). Don't worry though, we have to release it soon anyway, because we're almost out of money :D

Compared to, say, a year ago, Co OPERATION feels like it's changed quite a lot. So if you haven't played it recently, please do so and then drop us some [url=https://discord.com/invite/5RSq85mQ6q]feedback in Discord[/url] or via the in-game feedback form.

v0.8.2 Patch Notes

🎲 Big change! You now see all player characters execute actions one at a time, so it’s easier to follow and understand what is happening.
🌎 30 languages now supported for UI and dialogue!
🎲 New “patient satisfaction” stats and ranking system added!
🎲 16 wards in the game now and existing levels have been improved.
🎲 You can shrink all the upgrades bought from the shop with the Shrink-Prod, including the Shrink-Prod!
🎨 UI on item voting is much more clear and more fun now.
🎨 Improved UI after administering medicine to patients.
🎨 Brightness, contrast, gamma and other post processing effects are more balanced so the game looks better.
🎨 New “wait” animation for all player characters.
🔧Better Anti-aliasing choice for sharper looking images.
🔧New dynamic camera added
🐞 Bug fix: Player names are referenced properly by NPC dialogue.
🎵 New music tracks added, now 17 in the game!
🎲 New luxury bed-upgrade added.
🐞 Various bug fixes and tweaks.
For modders:
🐞 Bug fix: keyboard controls work normally again in the Level Design scene.
🐞 Bug fix:BlockThrow tag works as expected.
🔧More than 4 items can be added to item vote management.
🔧More control available over the dynamic camera.
🔧Various improvements and fixes.

Cheers,
Shaz
Game designer & co-founder at Mind Feast Games

notes.title: Co OPERATION v0.8.0 - We changed the core gameplay
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/976a9e55e65b7ba027c8cf31a78757b60b3e9b0c.jpg[/img]

We've been working on some big changes. We changed the core gameplay of Co Operation..! Over the last [insert far too many number of years] we've been paying attention to playtests, observing how our great Discord community get on with each new update and asking them for feedback. It's clear that the main appeal of the game is in the sense of tactical mastery - of thinking about and then lining up a clever set of moves and then watching your plan work out well. If you're playing in multiplayer mode then that shared sense of mastery with your co-op buddies is even more satisfying.

In v0.8 we've added some features which lean into that feeling of mastery more. Healing patients now feels more tactical and you have to think about which patients to treat first more carefully. You can then buy and upgrade a range of items in the level hub which give you different benefits while playing each ward. The decisions you make in the hub will impact the tactics you chose in each ward. In each ward the possibility space is now bigger so the tactical element feels richer and also the strategic element of deciding what to do in the long term, across multiple wards, feels more satisfying.

I'm pretty excited about this update. This is def turning out to be the best game I've ever worked on..!

v0.8 patch notes:
[list]
[*] 🎲 Gameplay feels more tactical in each ward and more strategic as a “meta” game:
[*] Patients have e.g. 8/9 health (but this varies per patient).
[*] Medicines heal by +4 health points by default.
[*] You need to restore patient health all the way to their max health or over to heal them.
[*] Patients reward you with money each time they are healed.
[*] The reward value is based on how much health they have, multiplied by 2 or 3 if they are in an upgraded bed, which you can purchase in the level hub.
[*] You can upgrade your medicine dispensers in the level-hub, so they give +8 health points.
[*] Money earned is clearly visible in wards and in the hub.
[*] Some wards allow you to place more than 3 purchased/upgraded items in the pre-ward voting round.
[*] Game economy and progression tweaked so upgradable and purchasable items feel fun to collect and use in combination.
[*] 🎨 UI adjustments so you can see all the info you need about patient health and medicine healing points in order to plan out the most effective tactics in each ward.
[*] 🎨 Level hub looks nicer.
[*] 🎲 Level 8 changed to be more fun. Various other level tweaks to better fit with the improved gameplay.
[/list]
🔧Network improvements.
🐞 Various bug fixes.

For modders:
[list]
[*] You can now add custom text meshes to level objects.
[*] New medicine health indicators can have their positions customised.
[*] Various improvements.
[/list]

Cheers,
Shaz
Game designer & co-founder at Mind Feast Games

notes.title: v0.7 - New Game Mode & Gameplay Improvements
notes.notes:
Demo v0.7 of Co OPERATION: MultiTurn is now live! There are a lot of changes and improvements. Below is the full list. You can let us know what you think of the new updates [url=https://discord.gg/5RSq85mQ6q]over on our Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/9d7a01cc8ec2931e45d717887cc03febcadf09e2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] ⚙️ New gameplay option: “Thinky” and “chilled” modes. When starting a game session, choose to have 4-turns-per-round, 2-turns-per-round or even 1-turn-per-round. This is a significant gameplay option. The orig game makes you think 4 steps ahead. Maybe you want to have a more chilled session or play with a younger family member? Choosing to think 2 steps ahead each round is more simple and more chilled. Now you can decide each time you play.
[*]🎵 Music change: We’re still using music by Jazz artist Jim Rattigan. To play it safe we’re now only using music that he has both written *and* self-released. This is to avoid any possible licensing disputes in the future.
[*] 📖 Dynamic narrative: Patients now have “mini story arcs” which activate and progress, depending on player-actions.
[*] 🎲 Gameplay: you can throw objects over the heads of patients who are in a bed.
[*] 🎲 Gameplay: you can reuse a bed multiple times in a single round if you want to be super efficient.
[*] 🎲 Gameplay: you can throw objects over Cammy the chameleon whether they are in bed or not. Which makes sense, they're quite small.
[*] 🎨 Art: Medicines and their respective clipboards (next to the beds of patients) jump up and down to communicate that someone needs that thing..!
[*] 🎨 Art: More interesting and characterful idle animations when you input all your actions as “wait” aka don’t do anything in a round.
[*] 🎨 Art: healed patients have a happier icon in the narrative UI panel.
[*] 🎓 Onboarding: level loading hints added so new players better understand what to do.
[*] 🔧 Optimisation: Quicker loading times.
[*] 🐞 Bugfix: The level hub/shop correctly displays the name of the last ward in the results panel
[*] 🐞 Bugfix: when voting on item locations, the “ready” button can’t be accidentally pressed multiple times.
[*] 🐞 Bug fix: characters and objects spawn correctly and don’t do a “glitch in the matrix” double-spawn.
[*] 🐞 Bug fix: Characters who start in bed still actually have legs when spawning.
[*] 🐞 Bugfix: Our WIP translation option has been completely disabled (again!) - meaning that English is always chosen, even if your Windows is set to a different language. In the future we hope to have various language options.
[*] 🐞 Various optimisations and bugfixes.
[/list]

For Modders:
[list]
[*] Debugging improvements - errors are now clickable and will take you to the relevant line in the relevant script.
[*] MP3 sound support added.
[*] Tweens can be defined in YAML
[*] More flexibility on when to start and stop sounds
[*] Scripts can access more of each others' global variables.
[*] Moves entered now available to Lua
[*] Various optimisations and bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.6.4 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who used the in-game forms to send us bug reports and feedback forms! During Next Fest we had 140 forms sent to us and this was super helpful. We can make the game much better with your feedback. Around 14,000 people have added the demo to their Steam account. Did you play it yet? What did you think?

The v0.6.4 demo is now live. We're continuing to fix bugs and improve features.

Change log:
v0.6 through to 0.6.4
[list]
[*] Players with non-English Windows system settings can now load levels as normal
[*] Players with non-English Windows system settings can now load the shop as normal
[*] Bugfix: number of players added to game cannot be accidentally “spammed”, causing errors
[*] Level Design scene no longer connects to game servers unnecessarily
[*] Bugfix: on rare occasions an uncaught object caused an error, which has now been fixed
[*] All 4 player characters have now been updated to the new animation system. So as well as looking super lively and fun, modders can easily customise them.
[*] We fixed it so that when your character picks up an object... it actually looks like they are holding it (at the correct position).
[*] Made a few tweaks to the overall brightness, contrast and saturation to look a bit nicer.
[*] Throwing re-enabled in level 1. Although it's supposed to be a tutorial level where you can only do a few things to learn the basics... some players seem to expect the throw (maybe based on seeing a gameplay video etc), so we added it back in. Probably more fun to be able to mess about with throwing from the very start anyway.
[*] A fix for "loading curtains" sometimes not triggering correctly.
[/list]

Thanks for your continued support!
Shaz
Game designer & co-founder at Mind Feast Games

notes.title: Co OPERATION: MultiTurn - An Ideal Game for Remote Play Together?
notes.notes:
Co OPERATION: MultiTurn is part of the 2024 Remote Play Together Fest. After [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097840/Co_OPERATION_MultiTurn/]installing the demo[/url], you can invite up to 3 friends to help you heal the patients in each ward of Lonchester Hospital.

The core gameplay and control system is ideally suited for Remote Play Together or any other streaming software. That’s because Co OPERATION: MultiTurn is a simultaneous-turn-based game and if one or more players have e.g. a 0.5 second lag on their stream, the gameplay is not really affected and it’s still a fun experience.

Here’s how that works in-game. All players see a game map. You might see some patients or tiles where you know patients will spawn, hospital beds, different medicines types and a map layout with a particular challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/a1c0db4558c7117e69135fbe1423aa2ea206a7a0.jpg[/img]

As a team, you and your friends will likely discuss what you should do. While thinking and talking, all of you will schedule four actions. When everybody has clicked “ready”, all the characters will move and execute their actions at the same time on the shared game screen. You’re all on the same team and you all plan actions at the same time. So even if one of you has a small amount of lag in seeing the stream of the shared screen, it doesn’t really matter 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/ec639e2de5dc92d9383b13375e78aaf2a2c69778.jpg[/img]

We’ve created a controller system similar to the Jackbox series of games. Each game session has a join-code. Go to our URL on your computer, phone, tablet or anything else with a web browser and type in the join-code. You’ll then be connected to the host game session. This makes it super easy to invite your friends to play with you. They watch the shared game screen but control their character via their connected device.

In our testing, the combination of the core gameplay and the control scheme make Co OPERATION: MultiTurn a lot of fun to play over a stream, whether that’s on Steam Remote Play, Discord, Twitch or whatever.

Having said that, it doesn't really matter what we think… It’s more important what you think and whether you and your friends have fun playing it together. After you’ve had a go, please do let us know what you think. At the time of writing, the demo is as at v0.3.9. Feedback from our early players informs what improvements and features we add to the game, so let us know what you think..!

Cheers,
Shaz
(Game designer and co-founder at Mind Feast Games)

notes.title: Co OPERATION - Testing done, there are some bugs . . . 😬
notes.notes:
We did an initial test of the Co OPERATION demo and got some great feedback for how we can improve the game. We’ve been working away to fix those issues and are now gearing up towards a second demo play test! 🎉

What did we find?

The main issues we found were with players connecting and disconnecting to the game - we need to work on a way for players to rejoin a game easily if they drop out for any reason.

There were lots of fun bugs 🐛! There were a few patients spawning where they are not supposed to 😅 And at one stage, one player threw medicine to another, who threw a patient to them and the patient then disappeared! 💨

We also realised that nowhere have we included the backstory, so Josh has been working on that and come up with this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/147513183067be67839d0dba5140ea0e9f1aaea3.jpg[/img]

[b]Josh’s progression from sketch to finished comic strip[/b]


[b]New action buttons[/b]
We found that some of the action buttons that players use to programme their moves were a little confusing so Josh gave them a makeover! Even though Josh usually sticks to 2D art, we all thought the 3D effect on the arrow looked cosier and squidgier so we went with that. We want our game to be cosy and squidgy so it fits 🧸

Here’s an example of some of the spruced-up button art.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/d1d550c3e62384750040800b34f4a517e73e7205.jpg[/img]

[b]Action buttons for throw and moving in one direction[/b]


[b]Modding[/b]
Our modding tools are really coming along ⚒️ with lots of exciting new features from co-founder and programmer Rupert that make it easier to write and test your custom Lua scripts. This includes the ability to control players and run scripts in our level viewer! Joe (fellow programmer) added some new UI that visualises & lets you change the current game phase 💫

As you can see in this video, the Lua scripts in our Co OPERATION game package mean that changing the phase can cause new patients to spawn and health to reduce ❣️ But change a few lines of mod code and something entirely different could happen . . .

[previewyoutube=fiL3IbqSwNA;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Clipboards[/b]
How do you know what medicine to give your patients? We now have some handy clipboards which show you 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/b0de164872db30d5fa91bc5852bd20b39fa19b4a.png[/img]

[b]Design a poster[/b]
Last month we ran a poster design event. We asked our Discord community for ideas for posters that could feature on the walls of our in-game hospital world. We had some great ideas and Josh has turned them into these!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/52caab092ccd5540471864fee12c00d5ccf7a0f7.jpg[/img]

[b]The first idea came from James and the second from JFarceur (apparently this angry parrot is a thing in Canada) - thanks to both of them![/b]


Then Shaz added them into the game world and they turned out looking like this! 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/9fd083738882e48f3754be60733ec9b16b4e2323.png[/img]


[b]Universities[/b]
We’ve been working with three different universities 🎓 to help test the modding abilities of the platform we’ve developed called MultiTurn! 

We have students from Plymouth Uni who are working on a new mod of the game as we speak. Shaz has been working with students from Norwich who are also testing the modding code. And a researcher from Basel wants her students to evaluate Co OPERATION from the point of view of self-determination theory, or what really motivates people to play a game 🥕

We are really looking forward to seeing what these students come up with. Shaz (game/level designer) is especially excited to play a mod so he can play new content internally with the team (that he didn’t design!)

If you want to also be an early stage modder and/or play the next demo (due to be out in Dec some time?) then you can join our Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/5RSq85mQ6q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/9f8c40895321f8c29603be0785fd5477752d3408.png[/img][/url]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/63fb53b7c644f94dbc479ab53a901393031ec477.gif[/img]

[b]An amazing co-operative throw-chain![/b]


See you soon,
Shaz, Julia and the MFG team

notes.title: Co OPERATION - Who wants to play the demo?!
notes.notes:
The demo of Co OPERATION: MultiTurn will be playable in the next few days!! Eeep! 😲

[url=https://discord.gg/5RSq85mQ6q]Join our Discord[/url] to be part of the first live playtest of the demo!

[url=https://discord.gg/5RSq85mQ6q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/8463248e0d0f1b9da47ae92f2c6c41716af4e674.png[/img][/url]

The Mind Feast Games team of Shaz, Rupert, Josh, Kaitlin, Joe and Julia have been busy over the last month getting the game ready to be tested!

There’s too much loneliness in the world and we want to bring people together with this game 🫂 It’s multiplayer in a similar way to Jackbox and uses your phone as the controller 📲 to make it more accessible. Only one person needs to have the game installed and they can then stream it to others who’ll get a room code.

Think Jackbox BUT crossed with Overcooked and with little sprinkle of turn-based strategy too. Co OPERATION is a game where the fun comes from collaborating and winning together 🤜🏾🤛🏻

Also…

⚒️ Modding! Yes, you can also mod the game! You wanna put cats everywhere? You can! Joe and Rupert have added Lua code that you can change. Also, we use the same level editing system that you will (if you make levels).

So, what can you expect from the playtest? 👀 

🤸 Amazing animations. Josh has been adding carry and bump animations to all the characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/2dc3c9338440e1142dfe5c3a25567b6b6ee8a28b.gif[/img]
Tamira the athlete bumping into something - notice how her expression changes too!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/ca3849ffeddf68035851b0ae6916dcc35efcd37b.gif[/img]
Juggler Ethan with his wobbly nose! 


We want the patients to look sick but not too sick, so Josh animated one of them like this ⬇️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/c1abe148f6d9e31236ff3a2d3caabdaca133a90f.gif[/img]
Patient Grace with her intermittent cough 🗣️


Having the 2D animated players in a level really makes the game come alive, they are so nice and bouncy 🦘

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/5aaacd5a0d652224bb3e2c0377bb5ef162c8920b.gif[/img]
Players waiting for their actions 🤸


✨ Incredible UI. How are you going to know when a patient is nearly a goner? Joe’s added some handy hearts to show you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/8c0a7c4e8d7618bb4942a23d627b84c92904faab.png[/img]
Hearts will go down after each turn - can you figure out how to cure each patient before they go down to zero ❤️?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/4821856f7cc450b13daa77be72b9d0401d87a7a4.gif[/img]
Patients are usually super happy once they’ve been cured! Here’s patient Ed Banger rocking-out after being cured by the team! 🤘


🗺️ Lovely levels. Shaz has been pulling everything together to create 9 levels for 2, 3 and 4 players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/67c2b4440bd5184f023c6fa7cc9dd69c6470a682.png[/img]
How Level 6 is looking in 4 player mode


Like the look of all this and want to be one of the first to play the demo? [url=https://discord.gg/5RSq85mQ6q]Join our Discord[/url]*!

(*We also have regular events on our Discord! Live games, chats with other indies, longer drop in, drop out games and creative events such as design-a-poster for the in-game world!)

See you soon,
Shaz, Julia and the MFG team

What’s the story behind the game? Well, running hospitals is expensive. A clever bean in central government decided that tearing up requirements for medical qualifications would help. So… volunteers are now welcome in hospitals! 🤷 You decide to enrol and help your local hospital. You can be one of four characters whose specialist skills are throwing and catching; Jason the American footballer 🏈, Prisha the pizza chef 👩‍🍳, Ethan the juggler 🤹 or Tamira the javelin athlete 🏃‍♀️

Josh and Kaitlin, our two artists, have been working hard on these 2D characters and the 3D objects that you’ll have to navigate in the game.

Ethan the juggler idling, running and throwing 🤹

Shaz has been weaving together the 2D characters, 3D objects and hospital world to create some fun levels - here’s how level one in two-player mode is shaping up:

Joe and Rupert have been doing stirling work on the code, and the characters are now able to do 4 moves in a row without breaking the game engine 🎉 Joe has also revealed a hidden talent for UI (user interface) design and has created lovely selection screens for levels and characters:

notes.title: Co OPERATION: MultiTurn is coming...! Here's how you can get involved
notes.notes:
Hello Steam!

We flipped the switch! The page for our game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097840/Co_OPERATION_MultiTurn/]Co OPERATION: MultiTurn[/url] is now set to public 🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/061f1eb1f6c069384557abce5762d7aa5fa4449b.jpg[/img]

The experience is pure co-op. There's no competition between players, you’re all on the same side trying to heal the patients ❤️‍🩹 There are enough competitive games out there. We want to focus on games that provide a nice sense of togetherness. We feel there’s too much loneliness in the world and gaming can help alleviate some of that, especially if a game is designed for people to feel good while playing together.

Conveniently, only one person needs to have the game installed. Similar to Jackbox, the game controls are on phones 📲 which means you can play and enjoy a game session with your gaming friends and with people who don’t typically play video games. Have a video call with them and screen-share if you want to play remotely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/591b962fe47c54cd4b6f3d8cc0deb7deec96e969.jpg[/img]

We’re making this game to help people feel connected socially and emotionally. Here’s how you can get involved with the early demo or the more polished version which will come later:

[b]Wishlist the game on Steam![/b] That way you’ll be the first to know when it's available to purchase and play with your friends and family.

[b]Want to get involved before the demo is out?[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/5RSq85mQ6q]Join our Discord community![/url] You can chat with the team and the other community members and play games together (we have a weekly live games session as well as longer, asynchronous games that run over several days). 

The experience is all about teamwork, communication and fun. We want our development process to reflect that so we’re being very open. The Discord is also where we’ll be sharing our progress and concepts so you can see the game as it develops. We get the community involved in creative decisions for the game and company too - lots to get stuck into!

[b]Want to be one of the first people to play the demo once it's ready?[/b] [url=https://eepurl.com/h6o_vv]Join our mailing list![/url] 

Have any questions? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2097840/discussions/]Start a discussion with us on Steam![/url]

If you care about co-op games and like the idea of an inviting and accessible game that you can play with friends, family and partners while still having a gaming experience that feels like it has some depth… get involved 😊 Join us on Discord and/or the Steam forum and be part of turning this thing from a good idea into a great game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738505/c38b35c798d5cd2c65b60ae5c38e27a70e119cbf.png[/img]

Cheers,
Shaz and the Mind Feast Games team
